description: This Java class 'PersistedServiceJob' extends 'GenericServiceJob' and manages the lifecycle of persisted service jobs within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles job queuing, initialization, recurrence scheduling, failure handling, and context retrieval, with job data stored in the 'JobSandbox' entity. The class includes methods for creating recurrences, retry logic, and managing job states.

classes.name: PersistedServiceJob
classes.description: A class managing persisted service jobs, including scheduling, retries, recurrence, and state management within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: PersistedServiceJob
methods.description: Constructor initializing a persisted service job with scheduling and retry parameters.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Queues the job for execution, updating its status and ensuring it is available.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the job, sets start time, manages recurrence, and schedules next execution.

methods.name: createRecurrence
methods.description: Creates a recurrence of the job at the specified next time, handling UTC consistency.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks the job as finished, recording success or error message.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Handles job failure, manages retries, and updates job status.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Retrieves the service name associated with the job.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves the execution context for the job, including runtime data and user login.

methods.name: getRetries
methods.description: Counts the number of retries for the job based on 'JobSandbox' entries.

methods.name: canRetry
methods.description: Determines if the job can be retried based on maxRetry and currentRetryCount.

methods.name: getRecurrenceInfo
methods.description: Fetches recurrence information related to the job.

methods.name: deQueue
methods.description: Removes the job from the queue, resetting its state.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the scheduled start time of the job.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the job's priority, defaulting if not set.
